description:
Stress Relief Music | Bansuri Healing Session

If you wake up holding your breath without realizing it — start here. Bansuri is the closest sound to your own breath finally remembering itself. Let the flute breathe for you for an hour.

Solo bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) playing Raga Ahir Bhairav, tuned to 432Hz, with a subliminal Theta wave layer for parasympathetic stress release.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Solo bansuri — Indian bamboo flute, the most breath-driven instrument in classical music
- Raga Ahir Bhairav — morning healing raga, deeply contemplative with emotional weight
- 432Hz — healing frequency tuned to natural harmony
- Subliminal Theta wave (5Hz) entrainment layer
- Seamless looping texture, no abrupt transitions

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — first conscious breath
12:00  Breath finding rhythm
35:00  Body releasing
60:00  Settled morning calm
80:00  Gentle return

🧠 How to use:
Press play before your first task. Don't try to breathe deep — Bansuri's breath-pause structure trains your breath to slow without effort. Sit upright. Let the flute set the pace.

⏱ Best for:
• Morning cortisol / wake-up anxiety
• Held-breath stress states
• Pre-meeting grounding
• Pranayama / breathwork practice
• Generalized anxiety relief

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri and other Indian instruments
- Sessions tuned to specific healing frequencies
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release

— Raga Focus

Central figure: a serene woman in cream-and-gold sari with sage-green accents seated cross-legged by a still mountain stream at dawn, holding bansuri to her lips. Single dewdrop on a lotus leaf as visual breath-cue. Gentle morning mist rising from the water. Bold dark-teal serif overlay text reading 'BREATH HELD?' top-center, traditional Devanagari-influenced serif typography, high contrast for mobile readability. Aged warm cream parchment palette, single composed scene, no clutter.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Warm bansuri flute solo in raga Ahir Bhairav, deep grounding morning healing breath-driven mood, smooth breath-driven melodic flow with gentle gamak ornamentation, sustained drone-resolving phrases with natural breathing pauses, no percussion, no tabla, 432Hz tuning, 70-80 BPM, expressive melodic phrases with clear note movement and natural phrasing, cinematic meditation production, meditative but melodic, suitable for extended looping, begins immediately with first melodic phrase already in motion, no fade-in, no silent intro, full sonic presence from first note. deeply introspective, like breath held before release

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION: clip 1: 'deeply introspective, like breath held before release' · clip 2: 'gently hopeful, like tension quietly dissolving' · clip 3: 'deeply settled, like a body finally surrendering to rest' · clips 4-7 cycle. Ahir Bhairav tonic D. Morning tempo (70-80) is faster than healing/calm (65-70) per banked rule. Mix: Suno -3dB, Binaural -18dB, Tanpura -24dB. Bansuri must sound mid-register/warm, not high-pitched/shrill.
